outcome: Caesarean section for failure to progress
cohort: 11,687 singleton live births with cephalic presentation, attempted vaginal birth, and at least 37 completed weeks gestation
finding: There is a strong positive association between larger neonatal head circumference and both caesarean section for failure to progress and caesarean section for any indication.
mod_finding: Larger neonatal head circumference is positively associated with both cesarean section for failure to progress and cesarean section for any indication.
